text: Hello! It's the weekend. No school today! Welcome to your weather report for Sunday, September 20. It's Sunday, a good day to rest and get ready for the week. Shanghai is going to be under a blanket of cloud today. The warmest part of the day will be 29 degrees, and the coolest 22. It should feel gently warm all day. There is almost no chance of rain today. There are 5 days to go until a special day. Can you guess which one? A comfortable day for a walk, not too hot and not too cold. And here's a look ahead: tomorrow will be overcast, with a high of 29 degrees. Here's a question: what is the best thing about today? And that's it for today's weather. Have a lovely time!
